sn3.5:2.2: Great King, those who do bad things by way of body, speech, and mind …
sn3.5:2.5: Because, Great King, such protection is exterior, not interior;
sn3.5:2.7: Great King, those who do good things by way of body, speech, and mind
sn3.5:2.9: Even if they’re not protected by a company of elephants, cavalry, chariots, or infantry,
sn3.5:2.12: Because, Great King, such protection is interior, not exterior;
